'''Jax Stog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] residing on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jax Stog appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Ord Mantell. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
